references.text: All the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall fear you. This shows that God's name is placed over his people as a sign of belonging and blessing.
My people, over whom my name is called. The expression 'to set God's name over' indicates ownership and protection.
Everyone who is called by my name, whom I created for my glory. God's name over the people shows their identity as his possession.
The Lord set apart the tribe of Levi to carry the ark of the Lord's covenant, to stand before the Lord to serve him and to bless in his name. The priests' role in blessing in the Lord's name.
The priests, the sons of Levi, shall step forward, for them the Lord your God has chosen to serve him and to bless in the Lord's name. This confirms the priests' authority to bless.
I will bless you and make your name great. You shall be a blessing. God's promise to bless is fundamental to the covenant with Israel.
Θεὸς... ἀπέστειλεν αὐτὸν εὐλογοῦντα ὑμᾶς. God sent his servant to bless you. Fulfillment of God's promise of blessing through Christ.
Εὐλογητὸς ὁ θεὸς... ὁ εὐλογήσας ἡμᾶς ἐν πάσῃ εὐλογίᾳ πνευματικῇ. God who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing. The ultimate blessing from God upon his people.
τὸ ὄνομα αὐτοῦ ἐπὶ τῶν μετώπων αὐτῶν. His name shall be on their foreheads. Eschatological fulfillment of God's name being placed over his people.
May God be gracious to us and bless us, may he make his face shine upon us. An echo of the Aaronic blessing and God's blessing upon his people.
